result.brief: 提出按 token 估计全模型残差预测误差（截断误差与有限差分导数误差分解）来选择 Taylor 外推阶数，实现扩散模型免训练推理加速，并在 FLUX 与 Wan2.1 视频生成上验证。
result.reason: Token-wise Taylor order selection with residual error estimation accelerates diffusion inference, demonstrated on FLUX and Wan2.1 video generation; directly serves video generation efficiency.
